2608.10989.title: Putting Registers to Work: Task Registers for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
2608.10989.paper_summary: Token-pruning policies are usually designed for a single recognition pipeline, but pretrained Vision Transformers are reused across tasks with different spatial demands. We ask which parts of a pruning policy transfer across image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection. For each pipeline, controlled probes freeze the no-pruning checkpoint and apply a series of parameter-free reduction criteria at one eligible layer at a time without retraining. The probes reveal three differences: segmentation and detection rank the criteria differently, classification is especially sensitive to attention-based pruning in the earliest layers, and the dense tasks prefer opposite recovery endpoints. These findings motivate Task-Adaptive Pruning (TAP). Existing register tokens serve as task-agnostic storage for feature artifacts. TAP instead introduces one task register per task and activates only the current one. Its evolving state ranks tokens, distributes an exact removal budget over depth, and sets the recovery scale for dense features. At a final keep rate of $ρ=0.5$, our jointly adapted model, TAP-J, reaches $47.0$ mIoU at $1.30\times$ encoder throughput on ADE20K and $53.7$ box AP at $1.32\times$ encoder throughput on COCO while remaining competitive on ImageNet-1K.
2608.10989.paper_summary_zh: Token-pruning 策略通常是為單一識別管道設計的，但預訓練的 Vision Transformers 在不同的空間需求任務中被重複使用。<lb/>我們詢問哪些修剪政策的部分可以在圖像分類、語義分割和物體檢測之間轉移。<lb/>對於每個管道，控制探針凍結無修剪的檢查點，並在每次一個合格層上應用一系列無參數的減少標準，而不進行重新訓練。<lb/>這些探針揭示了三個差異：分割和檢測對標準的排名不同，分類對於最早層的基於注意力的修剪特別敏感，而密集任務則偏好相反的恢復端點。<lb/>這些發現促使了任務自適應修剪 (TAP)。<lb/>現有的註冊標記作為特徵工件的任務無關存儲。<lb/>TAP 則為每個任務引入一個任務註冊器，只激活當前的那一個。<lb/>其不斷演變的狀態對標記進行排名，將準確的移除預算分配到深度上，並設置密集特徵的恢復比例。<lb/>在最終保持率 $ρ=0.5$ 時，我們共同調整的模型 TAP-J 在 ADE20K 上達到 $47.0$ mIoU，編碼器吞吐量為 $1.30\times$，在 COCO 上達到 $53.7$ box AP，編碼器吞吐量為 $1.32\times$，同時在 ImageNet-1K 上保持競爭力。
